svg.title: Ops AI architecture: identity, observability and secrets across the top; people, the platform, both gateways and outside systems; dependencies; build to deploy

g.text: Enterprise IdP (Entra ID · Okta · Keycloak) → platform-service issues tokens → every service verifies them locally
Structured events and run journals → OpenTelemetry collector → APM and trace store
Vault · Key Vault · Secrets Manager → OPS_* environment → one settings class per process
SHARED SERVICES · USED BY AGENTS AND WORKFLOWS
DEPENDENCIES · DATA THE PLATFORM CONNECTS TO
PostgreSQL today · SQL Server, Azure SQL
⇄ pink lines: agents inside workflows, workflows as tools
→ APM · LangSmith or Langfuse · data lake
